column1: # All 193 UN member states from Wikipedia's Category:Member_states_of_the_United_Nations
# (redirects resolved; 2 miscategorized non-country pages excluded, see notebook Step 1).

column5: description
Afghanistan, officially the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan, is a landlocked country located at the crossroads of Central and South Asia.
Albania, officially the Republic of Albania, is a country in Southeast Europe.
Algeria, officially the People's Democratic Republic of Algeria, is a country in the Maghreb region of North Africa.

Andorra, officially the Principality of Andorra, is a landlocked country on the Iberian Peninsula, in the eastern Pyrenees in southwestern Europe, bordered by France to the north and Spain to the south.
Angola, officially the Republic of Angola, is a country on the western coast of Southern Africa.
Antigua and Barbuda is an archipelagic country in the Caribbean composed of Antigua, Barbuda, and dozens of other small islands.
Argentina, officially the Argentine Republic, is a country in the far south of South America.
Armenia, officially the Republic of Armenia, is a landlocked country in the Armenian highlands of West Asia.
Australia, officially the Commonwealth of Australia, is a country comprising the mainland of the Australian continent, the island of Tasmania and numerous smaller islands.
Austria, formally the Republic of Austria, is a landlocked country in Central Europe, lying in the Eastern Alps.
Azerbaijan, officially the Republic of Azerbaijan, is a transcontinental landlocked country at the boundary of Western Asia and Eastern Europe.
Bahrain, officially the Kingdom of Bahrain, is an island country in the eastern part of Arabian Peninsula in West Asia.
Bangladesh, officially the People's Republic of Bangladesh, is a country in South Asia.
Barbados is an island nation in the Caribbean located in the Atlantic Ocean.
Belarus, officially the Republic of Belarus, is a landlocked country in Eastern Europe.
Belgium, officially the Kingdom of Belgium, is a country in Northwestern Europe.
Belize is a country on the north-eastern coast of Central America.
Benin, officially the Republic of Benin, formerly known as Dahomey, is a country in West Africa.

Bhutan, officially the Kingdom of Bhutan, is a landlocked country in South Asia, located in the Eastern Himalayas, bordering China's Tibet Autonomous Region to the north and northwest and India to the south and southeast.
Bolivia, officially the Plurinational State of Bolivia, is a landlocked country located in central South America.
Bosnia and Herzegovina, often referred to as Bosnia-Herzegovina or simply Bosnia, is a country in Southeast Europe.
Botswana, officially the Republic of Botswana, is a landlocked country in Southern Africa.
Brazil, officially the Federative Republic of Brazil, is the largest country in South America.
Brunei, officially Brunei Darussalam, is a country in Southeast Asia, situated on the northern coast of the island of Borneo.
Bulgaria, officially the Republic of Bulgaria, is a country in Southeastern Europe.
Burkina Faso is a landlocked country in West Africa.
Burundi, officially the Republic of Burundi, is a landlocked country in East Africa.
Cambodia, officially the Kingdom of Cambodia, is a country in Mainland Southeast Asia.
Cameroon, officially the Republic of Cameroon, is a country in Central Africa.
Canada is a country in North America.

Cape Verde, also referred to in English by its  Portuguese name Cabo Verde, and known officially as the Republic of Cabo Verde, is an archipelagic country in the eastern Atlantic Ocean, off the coast of West Africa.
The Central African Republic (CAR) is a landlocked country in Central Africa.
Chad, officially the Republic of Chad, is a landlocked country in Central Africa.
Chile, officially the Republic of Chile, is a country in the Southern Cone of southwestern South America.
China, officially the People's Republic of China (PRC), is a country in East Asia.
Colombia, officially the Republic of Colombia, is a country located in South America, with insular regions in North America.
The Comoros,  officially the Union of the Comoros, is an archipelagic country made up of three islands in Southeast Africa, located at the northern end of the Mozambique Channel in the Indian Ocean.
Costa Rica, officially the Republic of Costa Rica, is a country in Central America.
Croatia, officially the Republic of Croatia, is a country in Central and Southeastern Europe, on the coast of the Adriatic Sea.
Cuba, officially the Republic of Cuba, is an island country in the Caribbean.
Cyprus, officially the Republic of Cyprus, is an island country in the eastern Mediterranean Sea, located off the coast of the Levant mainland in West Asia.
The Czech Republic, also known as Czechia and historically known as Bohemia, is a landlocked country in Central Europe.
The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), also known as the DR Congo, Congo-Kinshasa, or simply the Congo, and formerly named Zaire, is a country in Central Africa.
Denmark is a Nordic country in Northern Europe.

Djibouti, officially the Republic of Djibouti, is a country in the Horn of Africa, bordered by Somalia to the south, Ethiopia to the southwest, Eritrea in the north, and the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden to the east.
Dominica officially the Commonwealth of Dominica, is an island country in the Caribbean.
The Dominican Republic is an island country on the eastern part of the Caribbean island of Hispaniola in the Greater Antilles of the Caribbean Sea in the North Atlantic Ocean.
Ecuador, officially the Republic of Ecuador, is a country in northwestern South America, bordered by Colombia on the north, Peru on the east and south, and the Pacific Ocean on the west.
Egypt, officially the Arab Republic of Egypt, is a country spanning the northeast corner of Africa and southwest corner of Asia via the Sinai Peninsula.
El Salvador, officially the Republic of El Salvador, is a sovereign nation in Central America.
Equatorial Guinea, officially the Republic of Equatorial Guinea, is a country on the west coast of Central Africa and the only Spanish-speaking country in Africa.
Eritrea, officially the State of Eritrea, is a country in the Horn of Africa region of East Africa.
Estonia, officially the Republic of Estonia, is a country in the Baltic region of Northern Europe.
Eswatini, formally the Kingdom of Eswatini (historically called KaNgwane), also known by its former official names Swaziland and the Kingdom of Swaziland, is a landlocked country in Southern Africa.
Ethiopia, officially the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia (FDRE), is a landlocked country located in the Horn of Africa region of East Africa.
The Federated States of Micronesia (FSM), or simply Micronesia ( ), is an island country in Micronesia, a region of Oceania.
Fiji, officially the Republic of Fiji, is an archipelagic country in Melanesia, part of Oceania in the South Pacific Ocean.
Finland, officially the Republic of Finland, is a Nordic country in Northern Europe.
France, officially the French Republic, is a country primarily located in Western Europe.
Gabon, officially the Gabonese Republic, is a country on the Atlantic coast of Central Africa, lying on the equator.
Georgia is a country in the Caucasus region on the east coast of the Black Sea.
Germany, officially the Federal Republic of Germany, is a country in Western and Central Europe.
Ghana, officially the Republic of Ghana, is a country in West Africa.
Greece, officially the Hellenic Republic, is a country in Southeastern Europe.
Grenada is an archipelagic country of the West Indies in the eastern Caribbean Sea.
Guatemala, officially the Republic of Guatemala, is a country in northern Central America.
Guinea, officially the Republic of Guinea, is a coastal country located in West Africa.
Guinea-Bissau, officially the Republic of Guinea-Bissau, is a country in West Africa that covers 36,125 square kilometres (13,948 sq mi) with an estimated population of 2,080,000.
Guyana, officially the Co-operative Republic of Guyana, is a country on the northern coast of South America.
Haiti, officially the Republic of Haiti, is a country in the Caribbean on the island of Hispaniola in the Caribbean Sea, east of Cuba and Jamaica and south of The Bahamas.
Honduras, officially the Republic of Honduras, is a country in Central America.
Hungary is a landlocked country in Central Europe.
Iceland is a Nordic island country between the Arctic Ocean and the North Atlantic Ocean, located on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge between Europe and North America.
India, officially the Republic of India, is a country in South Asia.
Indonesia, officially the Republic of Indonesia, is a country in Southeast Asia and Oceania, between the Indian and Pacific oceans.
Iran, officially the Islamic Republic of Iran, and historically known as Persia, is a country in West Asia.
Iraq, officially the Republic of Iraq, historically known in the west as Mesopotamia,  is a country in West Asia.
Israel, officially the State of Israel, is a country in the Southern Levant region of West Asia.
Italy, officially the Italian Republic, is a country in Southern and Western Europe.
Ivory Coast, also known as Côte d'Ivoire and officially as the Republic of Côte d'Ivoire, is a country on the southern coast of West Africa.
Jamaica is an island country in the Caribbean, covering 10,991 square kilometres (4,244 sq mi).
Japan is an island country in East Asia.
Jordan, officially the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, is a country in the Southern Levant region of West Asia.
Kazakhstan, officially the Republic of Kazakhstan, is a landlocked country situated primarily in Central Asia, with a portion of its territory extending into Eastern Europe.
Kenya, officially the Republic of Kenya, is a country located in East Africa.
Kiribati, officially the Republic of Kiribati, is an archipelagic country spanning the Micronesia and Polynesia sub-regions of Oceania in the central Pacific Ocean.
Kuwait, officially the State of Kuwait, is a country in West Asia.
Kyrgyzstan, officially the Kyrgyz Republic, formerly known as Kirghizia, is a landlocked country located in Central Asia, lying in the Tian Shan and Pamir mountain ranges.
Laos, officially the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), is a country in Mainland Southeast Asia, and the only landlocked country in Southeast Asia.
Latvia, officially the Republic of Latvia, is a country in the Baltic region of northern Europe.
Lebanon, officially the Lebanese Republic, is a country in the Levant region of West Asia.
Lesotho (  lih-SOO-too; Sotho pronunciation: [lɪˈsʊːtʰʊ]), officially the Kingdom of Lesotho, is a landlocked country in Southern Africa.
Liberia, officially the Republic of Liberia, is a country on the West African coast.
Libya, officially the State of Libya, is a country in the Maghreb region of North Africa.

Liechtenstein ( , LIK-tən-stine; pronounced [ˈlɪçtn̩ʃtaɪn] ; Alemannic German: Liachtaschta), officially the Principality of Liechtenstein (German: Fürstentum Liechtenstein [ˈfʏʁstn̩tuːm ˈlɪçtn̩ʃtaɪn] ), is a doubly landlocked country in the Central European Alps.
Lithuania, officially the Republic of Lithuania, is a country in the Baltic region of Europe.
Luxembourg,  officially the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, is a landlocked country in Western Europe.
Madagascar, officially the Republic of Madagascar, is an island country in the Indian Ocean that includes the island of Madagascar and numerous smaller peripheral islands.
Malawi, officially the Republic of Malawi, is a landlocked country in Southeast Africa.
Malaysia is a country in Southeast Asia.

The Maldives, officially the Republic of Maldives, and historically known as the Maldive Islands, is an archipelagic country in South Asia, located in the Indian Ocean, near the southeastern boundary of the Arabian Sea.
Mali, officially the Republic of Mali, is a landlocked country in West Africa.
Malta, officially the Republic of Malta, is an island country located in the central Mediterranean Sea.
The Marshall Islands, officially the Republic of the Marshall Islands, is an archipelagic country in Oceania.
Mauritania, officially the Islamic Republic of Mauritania, is a country in the Maghreb region of West Africa.

Mauritius, officially the Republic of Mauritius, is an island country in the Indian Ocean, located about 1,100 nautical miles (2,000 km; 1,300 mi) off the southeastern coast of Africa, east of Madagascar.
Mexico, officially the United Mexican States, is a country in North America.
Moldova, officially the Republic of Moldova, is a landlocked country in Eastern Europe, with an area of 33,843 km2 (13,067 sq mi) and a population of 2.38 million.
Monaco, officially the Principality of Monaco, is a sovereign city-state and microstate in Western Europe.
Mongolia is a landlocked country in East Asia.
Montenegro is a country in Southeast Europe, on the Balkan Peninsula.
Morocco, officially the Kingdom of Morocco, is a country in the Maghreb region of North Africa.

Mozambique, officially the Republic of Mozambique, is a country in Southeast Africa bordered by the Indian Ocean to the east, Tanzania to the north, Malawi and Zambia to the northwest, Zimbabwe to the west, and Eswatini and South Africa to the south and southwest.
Myanmar, officially the Republic of the Union of Myanmar and also referred to as Burma (the official English name until 1989), is a country in northwest Southeast Asia.
Namibia, officially the Republic of Namibia, is a country in Southern Africa.
Nauru, officially the Republic of Naoero, is an island country and microstate in the South Pacific Ocean.
Nepal, officially the Federal Democratic Republic of Nepal, is a landlocked country in South Asia.
The Netherlands, also informally known as Holland, is a country in Northwestern Europe, with overseas territories in the Caribbean.
New Zealand is an island country in the southwestern Pacific Ocean.
Nicaragua, officially the Republic of Nicaragua, is a country in Central America, comprising 130,370 square kilometers (50,340 sq mi).
Niger, officially the Republic of the Niger, is a landlocked country in West Africa.
Nigeria, officially the Federal Republic of Nigeria, is a country in West Africa between the Sahel to the north and the Gulf of Guinea in the Atlantic Ocean to the south.
North Korea, officially the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), is a country in East Asia.
North Macedonia, officially the Republic of North Macedonia, is a landlocked country in Southeast Europe.

Norway, officially the Kingdom of Norway, is a Nordic country comprising the western and northernmost parts of the Scandinavian Peninsula in Northern Europe, the remote Arctic island Jan Mayen and the archipelago Svalbard.
Oman, officially the Sultanate of Oman, is a country in the southeastern Arabian Peninsula in West Asia.
Pakistan, officially the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, is a country in South Asia.
Palau, officially the Republic of Palau, is an island country located in the Micronesia subregion of Oceania in the western Pacific Ocean.
Panama, officially the Republic of Panama, is a country located at the southern end of Central America in North America, bordering South America.

Papua New Guinea (PNG), officially the Independent State of Papua New Guinea, is an island country in Oceania that comprises the eastern half of the island of New Guinea and offshore islands in Melanesia, a region of the southwestern Pacific Ocean north of Australia.
Paraguay, officially the Republic of Paraguay, is a landlocked country located in the central region of South America.
Peru, officially the Republic of Peru, is a country in western South America.
The Philippines, officially the Republic of the Philippines, is an archipelagic country in Southeast Asia.
Poland, officially the Republic of Poland, is a country in Central Europe.
Portugal, officially the Portuguese Republic, is a country in Southwestern Europe.
Qatar, officially the State of Qatar, is a country in West Asia.
Ireland (Irish: Éire [ˈeːɾʲə] ), also known as the Republic of Ireland (Poblacht na hÉireann), is a country in Northwestern Europe.
The Republic of the Congo, also known as Congo-Brazzaville, the Congo Republic or simply Congo, is a country located on the western coast of Central Africa to the west of the Congo River.
Romania is a country in Central and Southeastern Europe.
Russia, or the Russian Federation, is a country in Eastern Europe and North Asia.
Rwanda, officially the Republic of Rwanda, is a landlocked country in East Africa.

Saint Kitts and Nevis (SKN), officially the Federation of Saint Christopher and Nevis or the Federation of Saint Kitts and Nevis, is an island country located in the Caribbean consisting of the two islands of Saint Kitts and Nevis, in the Leeward Islands chain of the Lesser Antilles.
Saint Lucia (also written as St.
Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, sometimes known simply as Saint Vincent, is an archipelagic country in the eastern Caribbean.
Samoa, officially the Independent State of Samoa, is an island country in Polynesia, a part of Oceania, which is in the South Pacific Ocean.
San Marino, officially the Republic of San Marino (RSM), is a landlocked country in Southern Europe, completely surrounded by Italy.
Saudi Arabia, officially the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA),  is a country in West Asia that occupies the bulk of the Arabian Peninsula.
Senegal, officially the Republic of Senegal, is the westernmost country of mainland West Africa, situated along the Atlantic Ocean coast.
Serbia, officially the Republic of Serbia, is a landlocked country in Southeastern and Central Europe.

Seychelles ( , ; French: [sɛʃɛl] or [seʃɛl]), officially the Republic of Seychelles (French: République des Seychelles; Seychellois Creole: Repiblik Sesel), is an archipelagic country consisting of 115 islands in the Indian Ocean.
Sierra Leone, officially the Republic of Sierra Leone, is a country on the west coast of West Africa.
Singapore, officially the Republic of Singapore, is an island country in Southeast Asia.
Slovakia, officially the Slovak Republic, is a landlocked country in Central Europe.
Slovenia, officially the Republic of Slovenia, is a country in Central Europe.
Solomon Islands, also known simply as the Solomons, is an archipelagic country consisting of six major islands and over 1,000 smaller islands in Melanesia, Oceania, to the north-east of Australia.
Somalia, officially the Federal Republic of Somalia, is the easternmost country in continental Africa.
South Africa, officially the Republic of South Africa (RSA), is the southernmost country in Africa.
South Korea, officially the Republic of Korea (ROK), is a country in East Asia.
South Sudan (), officially the Republic of South Sudan, is a landlocked country in East Africa.
Spain, officially the Kingdom of Spain, is a country in Southern and Western Europe with territories in North Africa.
Sri Lanka, officially the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, formerly known as Ceylon, is an island country in South Asia.
Sudan, officially the Republic of the Sudan, is a country in Northeast Africa.
Suriname,  officially the Republic of Suriname, is a country on the northern coast of South America, also considered as part of the Caribbean and the West Indies.
Sweden, formally the Kingdom of Sweden, is a Nordic country located on the Scandinavian Peninsula in Northern Europe.
Switzerland, officially the Swiss Confederation, is a landlocked country located at the intersection of Central, Western, and Southern Europe.
Syria, officially the Syrian Arab Republic, is a country in West Asia located in the Eastern Mediterranean and the Levant.
São Tomé and Príncipe, officially the Democratic Republic of Sao Tome and Principe, is an island country in the Gulf of Guinea, off the western equatorial coast of Central Africa.
Tajikistan, officially the Republic of Tajikistan, is a landlocked country located in Central Asia.
Tanzania, officially the United Republic of Tanzania, is a country in East Africa within the African Great Lakes region.
Thailand, officially the Kingdom of Thailand, and formerly known as Siam, is a country located in Mainland Southeast Asia.
The Bahamas, officially the Commonwealth of The Bahamas, is an archipelagic country in the Caribbean located within the Lucayan Archipelago in the Atlantic Ocean.
The Gambia, officially the Republic of The Gambia, is a country in West Africa.
Timor-Leste, also known as East Timor, officially the Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste, is a country in Southeast Asia.
Togo, officially the Togolese Republic, is a country located in West Africa.
Tonga, officially known as the Kingdom of Tonga, is an island country in Polynesia, part of Oceania.

Trinidad and Tobago, officially the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago, is the southernmost archipelagic country in the Caribbean, comprising the main islands of Trinidad and Tobago, along with several smaller islets.
Tunisia, officially the Republic of Tunisia, is a country in the Maghreb region of North Africa.
Turkey, officially the Republic of Türkiye, is a country mainly located in Anatolia in West Asia, with a smaller part called East Thrace in Southeast Europe.

Turkmenistan is a landlocked country in Central Asia, bordered by Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan to the north, Afghanistan to the southeast, Iran to the south and southwest, and the Caspian Sea to the west.
Tuvalu (  too-VAH-loo) is an archipelagic country in the Polynesian sub-region of Oceania in the Pacific Ocean, about midway between Hawaii and Australia.
Uganda, officially the Republic of Uganda, is a landlocked country in East Africa.
Ukraine is a country in Eastern Europe.
The United Arab Emirates (UAE), also known simply as the Emirates, is a country in West Asia, situated at the eastern end of the Arabian Peninsula.
The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, commonly known as the United Kingdom (UK) or Britain, is a country in northwestern Europe, off the coast of the continental mainland.
The United States of America (USA), also known as the United States (U.S.) or America, is a country primarily located in North America.
Uruguay, officially the Oriental Republic of Uruguay, is a country in southeastern South America.
Uzbekistan, officially the Republic of Uzbekistan, is a sovereign, doubly landlocked country located in Central Asia.
Vanuatu, officially the Republic of Vanuatu (French: République de Vanuatu; Bislama: Ripablik blong Vanuatu), is an archipelagic country in Melanesia located in the South Pacific Ocean.

Venezuela, officially the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela, is a country on the northern coast of South America, consisting of a continental landmass and various islands and islets in the Caribbean Sea.
Vietnam, officially the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam (SRV), is a country at the eastern edge of Mainland Southeast Asia.
Yemen, officially the Republic of Yemen, is a country in West Asia.
Zambia (), officially the Republic of Zambia, is a landlocked country in Southern Africa.

Zimbabwe, officially the Republic of Zimbabwe, is a landlocked country in Southeast Africa, between the Zambezi and Limpopo River, bordered by South Africa to the south, Botswana to the southwest, Zambia to the north, and Mozambique to the east.
